## Overview

The bgms C++ backend is organized in three layers:

| Layer | Location | Role |
|-------|----------|------|
| Algorithms | `mcmc/algorithms/` | Pure functions: `nuts_step()`, `leapfrog()` |
| Samplers | `mcmc/samplers/` | Stateful objects: `NUTSSampler`, `HMCSampler` |
| Runner | `mcmc/execution/` | MCMC loop orchestration |

## Source Layout

```
src/
├── mcmc/
│   ├── algorithms/     # Stateless math
│   ├── samplers/       # Adaptation state
│   └── execution/      # Chain runner
├── models/
│   ├── base_model.h
│   ├── omrf/
│   └── ggm/
├── priors/
├── math/
└── utils/
```
